content:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: paging: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (prod-eu)

oncall-bot: Incident created — INC-2100000001. Priority: P1. Paging Ana (SRE).

Ana (SRE): I see spikes starting ~04:11 UTC. Error breakdown: 502/503 from envoy clusters, timeouts also up. Noted correlation with recent LB config push at 03:58 UTC.

Sanjay (Infra): Confirmed — deployed route weight changes to route `model-inference` 03:58 by infra-deploy-bot. Rolling update to envoy proxy config across eu-shard-2.

Mike (Runtime): Real-time logs show backend pods returning 502 with rapid retry churn. Example: `upstream response was 502` repeated then `upstream request timeout` after retries.

Leo (Eng): Could be retry amplification. If LB retries are enabled at proxy + client, we get extra load. Check envoy retry_on/max_retries.

Ana (SRE): Pulling config dump from one proxy:
```
curl -sS http://eu-proxy-1:9901/config_dump | jq '.configs[] | select(.type=="route")'
```
I see a route config: `retry_policy: { num_retries: 3, retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream" }` on the /v1/generate route.

Sanjay (Infra): That was part of the weight rollout. Shouldn't have changed retry policy, weird. Checking the diff from the commit.

OpsBot: Deploy log: infra-deploy-bot applied `routes.yaml` commit a1b2c3 — changed weights and inadvertently replaced a base route block.

Ana (SRE): Hypothesis: new routing sent a subset of traffic to a model variant with slower cold-start characteristics; envoy retries then amplified concurrent requests to that cluster causing 5xx overload. We should reduce retries and revert route weights.

CS Liaison: FYI: CS reported 3 customers in EU complaining of failed generations and timeouts ~04:12-04:20. No data loss reported.

Mike (Runtime): Can we quickly patch envoy to disable retries for that route and restore previous weight mapping? I'll prepare commands.

Sanjay (Infra): Prepared patch: set `retry_policy: null` for `route: /v1/generate` and restore weights to pre-deploy values (80/20 -> 95/5).

Ana (SRE): Applying patch to canary proxy eu-proxy-1 first.
```
# patch route on proxy via admin? We use k8s configmap -> rollout restart for gateway
kubectl -n infra set configmap envoy-routes --from-file=routes.yaml=routes-revert.yaml && \
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/envoy-gateway-eu
```

Leo (Eng): Can we avoid full restart? If we push envoy xDS delta via control plane, it's faster. Pushing through cpctl now.

OpsBot: control-plane apply accepted for eu-shard-2 (change id cp-7721). Propagating to proxies.

Ana (SRE): Monitoring: within 60s of canary change, 5xx rate on eu-proxy-1 dropped from 14% -> 1.8%. Latency also falling.

Sanjay (Infra): Rolling the same patch to remaining eu proxies now (rolling 1min stagger).

PagerDuty: Acknowledge — escalation paused while mitigation proceeds.

CS Liaison: Messaging to affected customers drafted: short apology + workaround (retry after 30s or use non-EU region). Share once PR approved.

Mike (Runtime): Follow-up: need to investigate why route weights change touched retry policy. Looks like templating bug in infra config generator. Creating bug: INFRA-2102.

Leo (Eng): Also creating evaluation alert for model-variant cold-start to avoid sending weight to cold nodes during high QPS.

Ana (SRE): Post-mitigation numbers: eu region 5xx now back to baseline (~0.2%). Total impacted requests estimated ~12% of EU traffic during window. No customer data loss.

Sanjay (Infra): Reverted commit a1b2c3 and created hotfix commit a1b2c3-hotfix with explicit retry_policy preserved. Will push fix for templating generator in next release.

Ana (SRE): Next steps before handoff: 1) Create incident timeline + root cause draft; 2) Attach config diffs and deploy logs; 3) Schedule follow-up postmortem with infra & runtime.

Mike (Runtime): I’ll join postmortem for model cold-start mitigations.

OpsBot: Handoff to on-call rotation: Ana stepping off in 30m; next on-call: Leo (Eng).

Ana (SRE): Handing off with current status: mitigation complete, monitoring green, follow-ups assigned (INFRA-2102, MODEL-EXP-421). If alerts reappear, escalate immediately. :thumbsup:

Leo (Eng): Taking over. I'll keep watch for another 1.5h then prepare RCA.

PagerDuty: INC-2100000001 transitioned to RESOLVED (status will remain open pending RCA).

CS Liaison: Notifying affected customers with root-cause note and timeline once postmortem is ready.

Ana (SRE): Final note — lesson: don't couple weight templating with route policy blocks. Keep retry config explicit.

Mike (Runtime): Thanks everyone.

Leo (Eng): Closing thread after we attach timeline + config diffs to the incident page. :white_check_mark:
